name: Enterprise Issue Cards
changes: The Pro notice for the local project list now has a Sponsor on GitHub button.
tip: A card keeps a local copy of the ticket. Select Refresh on the card to read the current copy from the server.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. Enterprise Issue Cards is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for using it.
